title: General Knowledge I: The Opening Round / General Knowledge II: Wider Horizons

questions.prompt: Honey is made by bees primarily from what?
questions.hint: Bees collect a sugary liquid from blossoms.
questions.explanation: Bees transform flower nectar into honey.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.hint: It lies in Ontario near the Quebec border.
questions.explanation: Ottawa is Canada's capital.

questions.prompt: In The Wizard of Oz, what color are Dorothy's famous slippers?
questions.hint: The film changed their color from the book's silver shoes.
questions.explanation: Dorothy wears ruby slippers in the 1939 film.

questions.prompt: Penguins belong to which animal class?
questions.hint: They have feathers but cannot fly.
questions.explanation: Penguins are flightless birds.

questions.prompt: Who invented the saxophone?
questions.hint: The instrument carries his surname.
questions.explanation: Belgian instrument maker Adolphe Sax patented the saxophone.

questions.prompt: In which year did Apollo 11 land humans on the Moon?
questions.hint: Neil Armstrong's first step came near the end of the 1960s.
questions.explanation: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in July 1969.

questions.prompt: Wimbledon is traditionally played on what surface?
questions.hint: Its lawns are part of the tournament's identity.
questions.explanation: Wimbledon is the major tennis championship played on grass.

questions.prompt: Who wrote Pride and Prejudice?
questions.hint: Elizabeth Bennet is the protagonist.
questions.explanation: Jane Austen wrote Pride and Prejudice.

questions.prompt: What does HTTP stand for?
questions.hint: Web browsers use it to communicate with servers.
questions.explanation: HTTP stands for Hypertext Transfer Protocol.

questions.prompt: Which painting gave Impressionism its name?
questions.hint: Claude Monet painted it.
questions.explanation: A critic derived the movement's name from Monet's Impression, Sunrise.

questions.prompt: Which bird is especially associated with the Greek goddess Athena?
questions.hint: It symbolizes wisdom.
questions.explanation: The owl is a traditional symbol of Athena.

questions.prompt: What is opportunity cost?

choices.text: The total amount of cash owned
The price printed on a product only
The value of the best alternative forgone

questions.hint: Choosing one option means giving up another.
questions.explanation: Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative sacrificed.

questions.prompt: Habeas corpus protects a person's ability to challenge what?
questions.hint: The phrase concerns producing a detained person before a court.
questions.explanation: Habeas corpus allows courts to review the legality of detention.

questions.prompt: Isotopes of the same element have the same number of protons but different numbers of what?
questions.hint: Their atomic numbers are equal but masses differ.
questions.explanation: Isotopes differ in neutron count.

questions.prompt: What does 'defenestration' mean?

choices.text: Throwing someone or something out of a window

questions.hint: The Latin root fenestra means window.
questions.explanation: Defenestration literally means throwing out of a window.

questions.prompt: What does a thermometer measure?
questions.hint: Its name includes the Greek root for heat.
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature.

questions.prompt: Pasta is most strongly associated with which national cuisine?
questions.hint: Spaghetti and ravioli are examples.
questions.explanation: Pasta is a central part of Italian cuisine.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.hint: It was selected as a compromise between two larger cities.
questions.explanation: Canberra is Australia's capital.

questions.prompt: Which instrument usually plays in a lower register than a violin?
questions.hint: It is a larger bowed string instrument.
questions.explanation: The cello is tuned and voiced lower than the violin.

questions.prompt: Which of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World remains substantially intact?
questions.hint: It is the oldest of the seven.
questions.explanation: The Great Pyramid is the only ancient wonder still substantially standing.

questions.prompt: What are antibodies?
questions.hint: They are produced by B cells.
questions.explanation: Antibodies are immune proteins that bind particular antigens.

questions.prompt: Who directed Spirited Away?
questions.hint: He co-founded Studio Ghibli.
questions.explanation: Hayao Miyazaki directed Spirited Away.

questions.prompt: How does an OLED pixel produce light?

choices.text: It emits light directly when current passes through organic material

questions.hint: Unlike an LCD, it does not need a conventional backlight.
questions.explanation: OLED pixels are self-emissive.

questions.prompt: The platypus belongs to which unusual mammal group?
questions.hint: Members lay eggs.
questions.explanation: Platypuses are egg-laying monotreme mammals.

questions.prompt: What is stagflation?

choices.text: High inflation combined with weak growth and unemployment

questions.hint: The term combines stagnation and inflation.
questions.explanation: Stagflation describes inflation alongside economic stagnation.

questions.prompt: What is magical realism?

choices.text: A style that treats extraordinary events as part of ordinary reality

questions.hint: It is strongly associated with Latin American fiction.
questions.explanation: Magical realism integrates fantastic elements into a realistic narrative world.

questions.prompt: What is a filibuster?

choices.text: A tactic used to delay or block legislative action through extended procedure

questions.hint: It is especially associated with prolonged debate.
questions.explanation: A filibuster obstructs legislative action by using procedural delay.

questions.prompt: Pointillism builds images from what?
questions.hint: Georges Seurat is closely associated with it.
questions.explanation: Pointillism uses small dots that visually blend at a distance.

questions.prompt: Stellar parallax is used to estimate what?

choices.text: The mass of dark matter directly

questions.hint: A star appears to shift as Earth moves around the Sun.
questions.explanation: Parallax converts apparent angular shift into distance.

questions.prompt: The Congress of Vienna reorganized Europe after the defeat of whom?
questions.hint: It met in 1814–1815.
questions.explanation: The Congress of Vienna reshaped Europe after the Napoleonic Wars.
